questions.question: What does Viola ask the Captain to help her do after the shipwreck?

options.text: Find a husband for Maria.
Take command of Antonio’s ship.
Persuade Olivia to adopt Sebastian.
Conceal her identity and enter the Duke’s service.

questions.explanation: Viola requests a disguise and proposes serving the Duke through her musical skills.

evidence.exact:
VIOLA.
There is a fair behaviour in thee, Captain;
And though that nature with a beauteous wall
Doth oft close in pollution, yet of thee
I will believe thou hast a mind that suits
With this thy fair and outward character.
I pray thee, and I’ll pay thee bounteously,
Conceal me what I am, and be my aid
For such disguise as haply shall become
The form of my intent. I’ll serve this duke;
Thou shalt present me as an eunuch to him.
It may be worth thy pains; for I can sing,
And speak to him in many sorts of music,
That will allow me very worth his service.
What else may hap, to time I will commit;
Only shape thou thy silence to my wit.

questions.question: How does Olivia react privately after meeting the Duke’s messenger?

options.text: She decides at once to accept the Duke’s suit.
She finds herself attracted to the messenger.
She recognizes the messenger as her dead brother.
She orders Maria to marry the messenger.

questions.explanation: Olivia describes the youth’s qualities entering her eyes as though love were an infection.

evidence.exact:
OLIVIA.
What is your parentage?
‘Above my fortunes, yet my state is well:
I am a gentleman.’ I’ll be sworn thou art;
Thy tongue, thy face, thy limbs, actions, and spirit,
Do give thee five-fold blazon. Not too fast: soft, soft!
Unless the master were the man. How now?
Even so quickly may one catch the plague?
Methinks I feel this youth’s perfections
With an invisible and subtle stealth
To creep in at mine eyes. Well, let it be.
What ho, Malvolio!

questions.question: How do Sir Toby and his companions exploit the belief that Malvolio is mad?

options.text: They appoint him commander of the Duke’s guards.
They send him to marry Olivia in secret.
They bind him and confine him in a dark room.
They make him fight Sebastian for his freedom.

questions.explanation: Sir Toby proposes dark confinement as a punishment and further entertainment.

evidence.exact:
SIR TOBY.
Come, we’ll have him in a dark room and bound. My niece is already in the belief that he’s mad. We may carry it thus for our pleasure, and his penance, till our very pastime, tired out of breath, prompt us to have mercy on him, at which time we will bring the device to the bar, and crown thee for a finder of madmen. But see, but see!

options.text: He believes Olivia hired her to steal his ship.
He mistakes her for Sebastian, whom he has helped.
He recognizes her as the officer who arrested him.

Than what befalls myself. You stand amaz’d,

questions.question: What discovery resolves the apparent presence of Cesario in two places?

options.text: Malvolio has been impersonating both twins.
Olivia has secretly hired two unrelated messengers.
Sir Toby has invented Sebastian to deceive the Duke.
Viola and Sebastian are surviving twins.

questions.explanation: The siblings compare their family history and recognize the brother and sister each believed lost.

evidence.exact:
SEBASTIAN.
Do I stand there? I never had a brother:
Nor can there be that deity in my nature
Of here and everywhere. I had a sister,
Whom the blind waves and surges have devoured.
Of charity, what kin are you to me?
What countryman? What name? What parentage?

SEBASTIAN.
A spirit I am indeed,
But am in that dimension grossly clad,
Which from the womb I did participate.
Were you a woman, as the rest goes even,
I should my tears let fall upon your cheek,
And say, ‘Thrice welcome, drowned Viola.’

No, sooth, sir; my determinate voyage is mere extravagancy. But I perceive in you so excellent a touch of modesty, that you will not extort from me what I am willing to keep in. questions.question: What future does Orsino offer Viola once her identity becomes clear?

options.text: She will become his partner rather than remain his servant.
She will govern Illyria in Olivia’s place.
She will marry Antonio to repay his help.
She will return alone to the sea with the Captain.

questions.explanation: Orsino releases her from service and offers his hand as her future husband.

evidence.exact:
DUKE.
Madam, I am most apt t’ embrace your offer.
[To Viola.] Your master quits you; and for your service done him,
So much against the mettle of your sex,
So far beneath your soft and tender breeding,
And since you call’d me master for so long,
Here is my hand; you shall from this time be
Your master’s mistress.
